blocks.text: There is a familiar way of describing solo mothers: strong, resilient, self-sacrificing. But while these words are often meant as compliments, even these positive labels can sometimes become a kind of box, reducing a woman’s story only to what she has endured rather than who she is, what she wants, and who she is still becoming. It is this space between identity and possibility that globally acclaimed Brazilian photographer Angélica Dass explores in “100 Portraits of Becoming,” TECNO’s two-year global storytelling initiative that brings together 100 real people and their evolving personal stories across Kenya, Saudi Arabia, Türkiye, Brazil, and the […]...
